en: Sepia-toned photograph of an old stone archway leading into a cobblestoned courtyard. Above the rounded arch, faint characters that look like a date are carved into the stone. Inside the courtyard, a building with plastered walls and multi‑pane windows is visible. Ivy or climbing plants cover much of the inner arch and wall. On the right side inside the courtyard stands a simple wooden handcart. The architecture is medieval or early modern European and the overall style suggests an early 20th‑century postcard.
